title: mimulus langsdorffii var. guttatus
intro: Mimulus langsdorffii var. guttatus, commonly known as monkey flower, is a plant species belonging to the phlox family and native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, and it has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote emotional balance and well-being. The therapeutic actions of Mimulus langsdorffii var. guttatus are thought to be attributed to its ability to support the nervous system and promote a sense of calm, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which may contribute to its therapeutic properties.
